title: Derevo
description: derevo.com.mx Derevo is a Mexican data and AI consulting firm founded in 2007 in Guadalajara and part of iLink Digital Group since 2021. It delivers full cycle analytics, from data strategy and BI to AI agents, and was the first Qlik implementation partner in Latin America. A Microsoft Solutions Partner for Data & AI with all five specializations and Fabric Featured Partner status, it was twice named US Power BI Partner of the Year. Its 160 plus consultants in Mexico, fully remote, serve over 250 clients including Bimbo, BMW, HSBC, Roche and Pfizer across retail, pharma and manufacturing. Its flagship product C-Agent lets companies query enterprise data in natural language through multi agent AI, and it runs the Agentic Life program with Microsoft. With offices in Mexico City, Monterrey, Dallas and Bogotá plus iLink's 800 global consultants and 280 million dollar group revenue, Derevo is scaling AI adoption across Latin America.
